rationale: With only 6 minutes to close, the stock is in a clear downtrend on the last 5 candles (from ~$19.73 down to $19.61), trading below VWAP ($19.68) and the 9-EMA ($19.66), sitting at only 21.9% of today's range. While the short-side momentum is visible, the 6-minute window to forced liquidation makes any meaningful risk/reward calculation unreliable — the ATR per 5m bar is $0.048, leaving almost no room for a stop and a viable target before market close forces an exit at an unknown price. The account is already down on the day, and the risk of slippage on a forced close outweighs any edge.
